description: Synthetic enterprise environment for demonstrating RecoveryProof. All data is fictional.

assets.name: Core DNS & Network Services
assets.description: Internal DNS, DHCP and core routing configuration.

assets.name: Identity Provider & SSO
assets.description: Workforce and customer SSO, MFA and directory.

assets.name: Secrets & Key Management
assets.description: Secrets vault and encryption keys used by databases and services.

assets.name: Orders Database (PostgreSQL)
assets.description: System of record for customer orders and fulfilment status.

assets.name: Central Logging & SIEM
assets.description: Security event collection, detection rules and log archive.

assets.name: HR Self-Service Portal
assets.description: Leave requests and payslip downloads. RTO/RPO never agreed.

assets.name: Analytics Export Bucket (AWS S3)
assets.description: Synthetic AWS-style resource: nightly analytics exports. No backup configured.

assets.name: Primary Backup Vault
assets.description: Same-account backup vault receiving all scheduled backups.

assets.name: Isolated Recovery Vault
assets.description: Logically air-gapped copy in a dedicated recovery account (daily copies).
